fun plan(pr: String): Verdict {
    val scope = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
    val changedFiles = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val repoContext = readFile(path = ".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
    val testDesign = readFile(path = ".repo_context/modules/quality/test-suite-design.md")
    val reviewChecklist = readFile(path = ".repo_context/playbooks/reviews/pr-review-checklist.md")
    val diff = readDiff(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
    val cliEntrypoint = readFile(path = "cli/command.py")
    val pythonTests = search(query = "disk_report OR subprocess OR cli", paths = listOf("tests", "cli"))
    val nearbyTests = readFile(path = "tests/kvtest/tests/python/test_deploy_worker.py")
    val findings = analyzeTests(scope, changedFiles, diff, repoContext, testDesign, cliEntrypoint, pythonTests, nearbyTests)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(scope, findings)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", contents = evidence)
    val signal = noop(message = "Tests-updated-appropriately evidence written; verdict inadequate because PR adds cli/disk_report.py without test coverage.")
    return makeVerdict(evidence, signal)
}
